billboard.title: Dev Log #1
billboard.summary: Building a personal site that feels like a workspace.

techStack: - Built with Next.js 16, React 19, and Tailwind v4. Radix via Shadcn for dialog, card, and button.
- Framer Motion for animations; react-rnd for draggable windows in the computer view. Custom pieces: desk hitbox, DesktopIcon, FolderWindow, menu bar.
- Typography: Newsreader for headings and Inter for body, via next/font with subsetting.

timeline.title: Now
timeline.description: This iteration is heavily inspired by Paul, Chester, Gregory and credit to this site for allowing me to find them. I wanted my website to feel like my desk, where everything on it tells you something about me. It may seem chaotic and I know that simplicity is the key to good design, but I just have so many ideas I want to explore! So to satisfy my drive to build, I'm adding whatever I find cool to this website. (MORE IS BETTER)
